title: Selected Work
subtitle: Audience expansion, AI-era product design, design engineering, and leadership — selected for n8n

application.positioning: Audience Expansion · AI-Era Product Design · Design Engineering Credibility · Leadership as Design

selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Primary positioning hook. The vibe-coding onboarding for non-database-savvy SMEs is a sentence-for-sentence parallel to n8n's central design challenge: 'extend Ninox's reach beyond the database-savvy without losing what made power users love it' maps directly to n8n's 'lower the floor without losing the ceiling'. Covers AI-era judgment + audience expansion + developer-facing UX + ambiguity in one story.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Design Engineering credibility — Design Engineering reports under the n8n Head of Design per the JD. A deployed Git+Style-Dictionary+Figma-sync system answers the 'evolve the design system and QA practices so the bar rises' brief with a shipped artefact, not an opinion.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: The single best evidence for the JD's HIGH-priority leadership cluster: performance calls (hired 1+1, let go 1+1), coaching the design lead, designing team norms to include a sidelined neurodivergent engineer. Frames leadership as a design problem — direct match for n8n's standards-culture, plain-voice JD. (Note: literal 'manage-managers plural' gap is acknowledged honestly in the cover letter per open-question Q1; this case study is the substantive depth proof.)
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Second AI proof and second design-engineering proof. AI-coded prototypes consumed by engineering directly in production, with team evangelism — direct match for the JD's 'Champion practical AI adoption inside the design org'. Executive format keeps it complementary to the design-system-API anchor.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Strategic influence + measurable impact: scope reframe from 'funeral-booking feature' to 'booking capability deeply integrated into the platform', 70% coordination-time reduction, 90% acceptance, delivered in 2 months on €20k. Dual PM + design role evidence for cross-functional-partnership credibility. Executive format because the in-depth narrative is long.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — craft-depth proof but narrower n8n fit; risks over-weighting Bibel TV in the featured surface.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — the CV references Datameer's 5-year director tenure as the scale anchor; the portfolio surface leans on Ninox + Bibel TV for n8n's specific AI / dev-tool / audience-expansion domain. Kept for those who go deep via ?all.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — the strategic-influence proof for those going deep; older (2014-16) and not n8n-domain-adjacent. ChurchDesk is the more current strategic-influence anchor for n8n.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — growth + competitive-strategy angle is good but narrower n8n fit; kept for ?all readers.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Hidden — second/third AI story, narrower scope. The CS-handbook-as-context Copilot pattern is good but ninox-ai-onboarding + bibeltv-agentic-engineering already cover the AI dimension.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantially overlaps bibeltv-agentic-engineering. Hidden to avoid surfacing two near-duplicate stories in the n8n view. (Also flagged 'in-progress' status with known AI-slop issues from earlier reviews; out of scope to fix here.)

gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.oss_community_product_leadership: Per open-question Q2 (answered 2026-06-05): no direct experience, no fabricated case study. Cover letter acknowledges as growth area and leans on adjacent community-product instincts.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.multi_manager_layer: Per open-question Q1 (answered 2026-06-05): managed 1 design lead + 5 ICs at Ninox, not 2+ design managers in parallel. Cover letter acknowledges honestly; CV stays focused on depth, not headcount padding.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.n8n_workflow_in_production: Per open-question Q3 (answered 2026-06-05): the four Bibel TV n8n workflows are documentation-only today. Aperto Bible-translation n8n workflow is being built this week as builder-signal. Once shippable, surfaces as a cover-letter reference + screenshot, not as a portfolio case study.
